products.name: Castelvetrano Olives
products.description: These vibrant green beauties are the best-selling olive in our antipasti case, and with good reason. Plump, juicy, and bursting with bright, buttery flavor, they make a perfect accompaniment to antipasti, tapas, or your next charcuterie board. Packed in brine and with their pits intact, they will satisfy any salty cravings while still feeling fresh, bright, and light.

products.name: DeLaurenti House Mix Olives
products.tagline: Made in our kitchen - marinated in herbs, garlic & citrus
products.description: Our House Olive Mix! Made in our kitchen, this is a delicious blend of country olives, marinated in a blend of herbs, garlic and citrus. Great for snacking and antipasti! Portioned by hand when you order it!

products.name: Lucques
products.tagline: The best olive you've never had!
products.description: The best olive you've never had. If you are one of the ones who has, then you know. Firm & buttery with just the right amount of acidity, this is the perfect snacking olive. Enjoy them out of the brine or drain the brine and lace them with your favorite olive oil, lemon zest & a sprig of herbs.

products.name: Greek Mix Olives
products.description: A handpicked blend of Kalamata, Mount Athos, and Mount Pelion olives. They are packed in brine with their pits intact, and seasoned with oregano and bay leaves. A very popular olive mix, this blend offers a fun variety of olives, and the seasoning is pleasant without being overbearing. These go great with feta, aged cheddar, hummus, or peppery salame.

products.name: Pitted Sicilian Olives
products.description: Kids can fit their little fingers in these babies and run around the house without the risk of poking themselves in the eye, you can use them in pasta, pizza, to make tapenade or drop in your Martini. Meaty, firm & mild, they are the skeleton key of olives.

products.name: Fratepietro Bella di Cerignola Olive, 500g
products.description:
The Fratepietro family business was founded in 1890 by Giovanni Fratepietro, and today is run by Giovanni’s great-grandson Andrea. He and his father Giovanni oversee the entire production process, ensuring these olives are among the best you can find on the world market. They are perfectly shaped Bella di Cerignola are carefully picked in October at ideal maturity, sorted by size and gently rinsed several times in a soda wash to take away any trace of bitterness. Finally they are soaked in a brine made with local salt from the nearby Margherita di Savoia nature preserve.

Bella di Cerignola is the largest olive in the world. Green or black in color, this typical Apulian variety has graced tables all over the world thanks to its high quality. Its cultivation has always been an important activity for Cerignola, a municipality in the province of Foggia, located in the north of Puglia, from which the fruit takes its name.

products.name: Moroccan Oil Cured Olives
products.description: These unique olives are packed with flavor! Ripe black olives from Morocco’s Atlas Mountains are first dry-cured in salt, which concentrates their flavor and reduces any bitter notes. Then, the salt is removed, and the olives are soaked in oil. The result is a deeply flavorful, briny olive. They are drier in texture than most olives, but they retain a decidedly buttery characteristic.

products.name: Partanna Calabrian Chili Olives, 180g
products.description: Partanna's Calabrian Chili infused Castelvetrano olives are spicy and savory, bursting with flavors that will make you dream of lounging at their Sicilian farm. These mildlly spicy olives are gently preserved in a brine with Tarpani sea salt and a hint of Calabrian chili. The perfect pairing to any charcuterie or snack!

products.name: Partanna Castelvetrano Olives, 340g
products.description: There is no mistaking the bright green, meaty, buttery qualities of a good Castelvetrano olive. Grown in western Sicily, they are the perfect addition to your spread of cured meats and cheeses.

products.name: Partanna Pitted Castelvetrano Olives, 260g
products.description: There is no mistaking the bright green, meaty, buttery qualities of a good Castelvetrano olive. Grown in western Sicily, they are the perfect addition to your spread of cured meats and cheeses.

products.name: Partanna Sicilian Lemon olives, 180g
products.description: Partanna's delicious Sicilian Lemon infused Castelvetrano olives are sweet and savory all at once, bursting with flavors that will make you dream of lounging at their Sicilian farm. These little gems are gently preserved in a brine with Trapani sea salt and a hint of Sicilian citrus. The perfect pairing with charcuterie, martinis with a twist or straight out of the jar!

products.name: Antica Valle d'Ofanto Olive Mix in EVOO, 290g
products.description: A blend Cerignola, Nocellara, and Leccino olives ready to set in a bowl for cocktails or parties. These snacking olives are great on their own as an appetizer. When you finish the olives, and you will, use the oil!

products.name: Bio Orto Organic Pitted Peranzana Olives in Oil, 190g
products.description: These organic pitted Peranzana olives are preserved in their own cultivar's extra virgin olive oil to enhance their distinct flavor profile. Firm & rich, the olives are hand harvested in Italy's Puglia region in the heal of the boot. They are perfect for snacking & salads, but earn their keep as the indespensible olive for your famous puttanesca sauce!

products.name: Bio Orto Whole Organic Peranzana Olives in Brine, 350g
products.description: These organic, whole Peranzana olives from Puglia are carefully washed, immersed in a saltwater brine and left to cure for a year. Hand harvested with care, these olive firm in texture and packed with flavor. Remove them from the brine and marinate in your own way, add them as-is to your antipasti platter or remove the pits and add them to pasta or salads!

products.name: Partanna Muffuletta Mix, 550g
products.description: Italian Muffuletta you say? Yes. Invented by Sicilians in New Orleans and elevated by Sicilians in Castelvetrano. This muffuletta combines the best Sicilian olives and vegetables to create a salad that works perfectly with ANY sandwich!

products.name: Contadini Leccine Olives in Brine, 550g
products.description:
Leccine olives are one of Italy's most beloved varieties, and Contadini's come from the Salento area in Apulia. They hand-pick them at peak ripeness, between October and November.

The process is simple and patient: after harvesting, they keep them in brine for about 6 months to reduce bitterness, then jar them in water, unrefined salt, and lemon juice. With just a short ingredient list and no artificial preservatives, these olives let you experience the true flavour of Apulian Leccine. Small in size and with an intense fragrance of freshly pressed oil, they're perfect as pizza toppings, in salads, or served during an aperitivo.

products.name: Contadini Termite di Bitetto Olives in Brine, 550g
products.description:
Known as "apple olives" for their size and roundness, these olives boast a full-bodied texture that pairs perfectly with aperitifs and fish dishes. Grown in the heart of Apulia's olive groves, near Bari, they are hand-harvested using time-honoured methods between October and November.

They are then preserve in brine for 6 months to remove bitterness without using artificial preservatives. The result is the beautiful Termite di Bitetto olive - a simple olive with a flavour that balances sweetness and pleasant acidity.

products.name: Divina Castelvetrano Olives, 7oz
products.description: The Castelvetrano has quickly become one of the world's most sought-after varietals. Native to Sicily, these olives are cured without fermentation and kept refrigerated, a key step that locks in its bright, emerald-green color and sweet, mild flavor. Be careful of the pit on these one's!

products.name: Divina Blue Cheese Olives, 13oz
products.description: These big green olives are hand-picked and stuffed with a creamy blue cheese! Perfect on their own or try them out in your next Bloody Mary!

products.name: Divina Cracked Green Olives, 6oz
products.description: Cracked with a stone during curing, these young green olives are mild, grassy and firm. Remove the pit all together and make tapenade, take them out and marinate them in olive oil & herbs of your choosing, or simple enjoy them right from the jar.

products.name: Divina Feta Cheese Olives, 13oz
products.description: Feta cheese and big green olives, is there a better mix? We love these olives, salty and savory stuffed with rich creamy Feta.

products.name: Divina Garlic Stuffed Olives, 13oz
products.description: Zesty pickled garlic complements plump, fruity Halkidiki olives from Mt. Athos in this savory snack. These olives are a great way to crank traditional Mediterranean flavors up a notch in a hearty farro salad or alongside cheese, hummus and pita.

products.name: Divina Greek Olive Mix, 6oz
products.description: Can't decide which olives you feel like? No need to. This is a delightful medley of Greek olives - Kalamata, Mt. Athos, Mt. Pelion Blond & Black, Gordal, and Nafplion - all in aromatic wild herbs. Easy-to-serve, even easier to enjoy.

products.name: Divina Kalamata Olives, 6oz
products.description: The iconic olive for pizza, pasta or salad. Firm and meaty, these beauties are estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula. Cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. These fruity, full-bodied, organic olives are a pantry staple.

products.name: Divina Marinated Feta & Olives, 360g
products.description: Divina's Greek Feta marinated with smoky and fruity olives is the perfect start to any happy hour or cheese board. And if that wasn't enough, it's wonderful tossed into grain bowls or chopped and stuffed into an avocado with some hot sliced peppers!

products.name: Divina Organic Pitted Green Olives, 6oz
products.description: These pitted green olives are organic, fruity and full-bodied. Estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula, they are cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. Essential in Greek salads, great on pizza, and perfect for your puttanesca sauce.

products.name: Divina Pitted Kalamata Olives, 6oz
products.description: These pitted Kalamata olives are fruity and full-bodied. Estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula, they are cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. Essential in Greek salads, great on pizza, and perfect for your puttanesca sauce.

products.name: Divina Smoked Kalamata Olives, 7.8oz
products.description: These wood-smoked Kalamata olives are packed with flavor! Deeply smoky and delightfully fruity, you're sure to love these in a grilled chicken salad with Feta, tossed into a bean or turkey chili or puréed with garlic and capers into a tapenade.

products.name: Divina Spicy Bloody Mary Olives, 13oz
products.description: The classic brunch cocktail just got turned on its head with the creation of a savory, robust and fiery Bloody Mary brine that’s matched up with Divina's classic pitted Mt. Athos green olives. And yes, once you've enjoyed the olives, the brine can go straight into your cocktail!

products.name: Divina Spicy Buffalo Blue Cheese Olives, 13oz
products.description: Break out the carrots and celery and get ready to harness your inner Buffalo spice in these fun and unique blue cheese stuffed olives. They are poppable and perfect in a Bloody Mary or served with wings!

products.name: Divina Sundried Tomato Stuffed Olives, 7.8oz
products.description: Hand-stuffed with savory sundried tomotoes, these olives are rich, robust and juicy. Try them paired with pasta or grain salads or for garnishing your Bloody Mary!

products.name: Donostia Anchovy Stuffed Olives, 7oz
products.description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. The sought-after Manzanilla is a straw-colored, plump, and meaty olive great for stuffing. Donostia’s olives are handpicked in Andalusia, naturally fermented, and cured in the Sevillian style. These ones are stuffed with minced anchovies from the Bay of Biscay. The umami flavor of the anchovies makes these olives pop. Marvelous on their own or as part of your antipasto tray.

products.name: Donostia Blue Cheese Stuffed Olives, 7oz
products.description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with Spanish blue cheese, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or as a light appetizer with a cocktail.

products.name: Donostia Lemon Paste Stuffed Olives, 7oz
products.description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. The sought-after Manzanilla is a straw-colored, plump, and meaty olive great for stuffing. Donostia’s olives are handpicked in Andalusia, naturally fermented, and cured in the Sevillian style. The lemon-paste stuffing adds a pleasant tartness to the olive. These make an impressive martini or bloody mary garnish.

products.name: Donostia Piquillo Olives, 49oz
products.description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with roasted Spanish piquillo peppers, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or of course dropped into a dry Martini. This tower of power ensures your status as an olive immortal.

products.name: Donostia Piquillo Olives, 7oz
products.description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with roasted Spanish piquillo peppers, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or of course dropped into a dry Martini.

products.name: Espinaler Anchovy Stuffed Olives, 12oz
products.description: These pitted Manzanilla olives are plump, mild and stuff with a generous portion of anchovy paste. Why do it your self when Espinaler has already done it for you? Great as a snack to boost your sodium stores - you can't have your calves cramping at cocktail parties folks! Spice them up with Espinaler's famous hot sauce!

products.name: Filthy Piri Piri Stuffed Olives, 8.5oz
products.description: These naturally cured queen olives are hand stuffed with care in Miami, FL with a red flame Piri Piri pepper, making them the near perfect accoutrement to your famous Bloody Mary!

products.name: Iliada Organic Jumbo Green Olives, 370g
products.description: These big fat Greek green olives are handpicked from organic olives groves. They have a firm crunchy-like texture and bright flavor. Great right out of the jar, or pitted and thrown into salads & pasta. Also perfect for marinating in olive oil, herbs, garlic and citrus.

products.name: Dequemana Arbequina Olives, 12oz
products.description: Dequemana Arbequina Olives are on the small side but they have a big distinctive flavor! Catalunya's olive of choice, they are also used very often to produce incredible Spanish Olive Oil!

products.name: Dequemana Empeltre Olives, 12oz
products.description: Dequmana Black Empeltre Olives are picked ripe and cured for 12-14 months to make a slightly sweet flavor. Very full and ripe, these are certainly a unique olive!

products.name: Dequemana Gordal Olives, 12oz
products.description: Dequemana Gordal Olives are perfect for that person who loves a big meaty olive! One of Spain's larger olives, these will be a hit on your Spanish charcuterie board!

products.name: Dequemana Mixed Olives, 12oz
products.description: Dequemana Mixed Olives are one of our favorite's here at the shop! A unique blend of several Spanish Olives that are marinated in Vinegar with Red Pepper and Garlic, savory for sure!

products.name: Regalis 5 Olive Mix, 345g
products.description: Can't decide which olive to get? Problem solved! This olive mix is a selection of uniquely traditional Spanish olives. Containing Natural Gordal, Manzanilla, Verdial, Cuquillo, and Cornicabra olives, this jar offers a mix of sizes, colors, textures, and flavors. A neutral brine perfects the ratio of saltiness to bitterness without compromising the flavor profile of each distinct variety they feature.

products.name: Regalis Cracked Verdial Olives, 345g
products.description: These verdial olives are cracked and marinated in smoked pimenton & laurel. The verial olive's firm, buttery flesh is packed full of flavor and ready to hit your tapas platter.

products.name: Regalis Hot Piri Piri Stuffed Gordal Olives, 345g
products.description: Large Gordal Olives are stuffed with small vibrant red piri piri north African chili peppers resulting in a deeply spicy, salty kick. Great on your antipasti platter or as a garnish in your Bloody Mary!

products.name: Regalis Orange Stuffed Gordal Olives, 345g
products.description: Sweet Navelina Orange rind is peeled and inserted into each olive creating a sweet, citrusy, umami packed wonder! Perfect for snacking or as a cocktail olive!

products.name: ItalBrand Caperberries, 15.9oz
products.description: Caperberries are the larger, pickled fruit of the caper bush, offering a milder, more olive-like flavor than capers. These preserved in brine and are perfect for salads, as a garnish for dishes like paella or seafood, or in cocktails. Their taste is briny and tangy with a crunchy texture, pick them up by the stem and eat them just like an olive!

products.name: ItalBrand Non-pareile Capers, 16oz
products.description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

products.name: ItalBrand Non-pareile Capers, 3.5oz
products.description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

products.name: Italbrand Non-pareils Capers in Sea Salt, 800g
products.description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. These capers are preserved in sea salt - give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

products.name: ItalBrand Surfines Capers, 32oz
products.description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Surfines (vs non-pareils) are slightly larger, from 7-8mm, and have a more robust flavor and a slightly crunchier texture, making them a good choice for sauces and dishes where the caper's flavor is a bit more pronounced. They are perfect such dishes as veal or chicken piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

products.name: Agostino Recca Caperberries, 490g
products.description: The fruit of the caper bush, caperberries are brined and oftentimes used like you'd use olives or pickles. Serve as garnish alongside antipasti dishes or drop them into a cocktail. More mild in flavor than capers, these caperberries can be used as a more subtle substitute in a variety of recipes.

products.name: Agostino Recca Capers in Salt, 500g
products.description: Agostino Recca isn't just about anchovies & fish. They are also about all the things that go with them. These salted capers are a perfect example. Firm, flavorful and preserved in sea salt, they are the essential ingredient in your pasta puttanesca, veal/chicken piccata or your bagel & lox.

products.name: Barral A La Provencale, 37cl
products.description: Barral Provencale Olives are a spicy mix of olives marinated with green peppers, pickles, and onions. Perfect for any charcuterie platter!

products.name: Barral Lucques, 37cl
products.description: Barral Lucques Olives are larger, meaty and have a particular sweet flavor. Very mild with basically no acidity, they are great to have with pate or crushed in a salad.

products.name: Barral Oil Cured Olive, 37cl
products.description: Barral Oil Cured Olives are harvested when ripe and dry-cured. They are mixed with olive oil and tossed with Provence herbs, becoming salty and aromatic!

products.name: Barral Picholine, 37cl
products.description: Barral Picholine Olives are a small meaty olive known for their firmness, nutty flavor, and shiny skin. Maybe the most famous of all French Olives, these are perfect with any Charcuterie.

products.name: Caravaglio Capers in EVOO, 200g
products.description:
Stunning Aeolian Island sunshine and sea breeze aromas abound in this jar. Precious Salina capers grown on the island of Salina, just off the northern coast of Sicily are heralded for their fragrant bouquet and delicate crunch. These prized flower buds are hand-harvested at optimal plumpness, then carefully sorted. The capers are set to dry for a few days in the sun, and then packed under sea salt where they undergo lactic fermentation. After 10 days, the capers are cleaned and packed again under new sea salt to age for an additional two months, allowing their floral flavor to blossom. They are then jarred and preserved in in extra virgin olive oil, salt, and wine vinegar, along with aromatic oregano and bay leaves.

Spoon Caravaglio capers straight out of the jar over grilled fish, roast chicken and sliced pork loin. Wonderful as a sauce to any seafood pasta dish, as well as the perfect condiment to pasta and rice salads.

products.name: Casina Rossa "Lilliput" Capers in Wine, 110g
products.description: Welcome to Gulliver's Travels folks. These Lilliput capers are the prize variety of capers. Tiny, rare, and delicate, they have a tangy flavor, and a firm texture. Preserved in a combination of white wine and prosecco, they are perfect for salads, bagels & lox, veal or chicken piccata and of course your pasta puttanesca.

products.name: Casina Rossa Caperberries in Wine, 180g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these caperberries are immersed in brightly-flavored prosecco. These are perfect for garnishing fish, meats, poultry and antipasti platters. These are also an excellent alternative to olives in your favorite cocktail.

products.name: Casina Rossa Caperberries in Wine, 110g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these caperberries are immersed in brightly-flavored prosecco. These are perfect for garnishing fish, meats, poultry and antipasti platters. These are also an excellent alternative to olives in your favorite cocktail.

products.name: Casina Rossa Capers in Sea Salt, 70g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these non-pareil capers are preserved in sea salt and ready to jump into action. Pasta, chicken, veal, bagels/lox, salads...you name it!

products.name: DeLaurenti Blue Cheese Olives, 10oz
products.description: It's a mystery...how do they get the blue cheese in there? We don't ask questions, we just enjoy the olives. These beautiful, firm green olives are a perfect addition to your antipasti platter or your Bloody Mary!!

products.name: DeLaurenti Blue Cheese Olives, 5oz
products.description: It's a mystery...how do they get the blue cheese in there? We don't ask questions, we just enjoy the olives. These beautiful, firm green olives are a perfect addition to your antipasti platter or your Bloody Mary!!

products.name: DeLaurenti Garlic Stuffed Olives, 10oz
products.description: Try our house brand Manzanilla olives stuffed with garlic! Handstuffed and handpacked, these olives are perfect in a mediterranean salad, on an antipasti platter, or dropped into a Bloody Mary.

products.name: DeLaurenti Pimento Stuffed Olives, 10oz
products.description: Our house brand Manzanilla olives stuffed with pimento! Hand stuffed and hand packed, they are the absolutely perfect Martini olive. The only question is whether or not you take 1 or 2.

products.name: DeLaurenti Triple Stuffed Olives, 5oz
products.description: Can't decide on what you want stuffed in your olives? Now there is no need. These beautiful Spanish green olives are ripe, firm and meaty and stuffed with either onions, pimento or almonds. Great in a martini or for simple snacking.

products.name: DeLaurenti Vermouth Olives, 5oz
products.description: Our house brand Manzanilla olives soaked in dry vermouth! The perfect olive for your cocktail!

products.name: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co. Vermouth Brined Olives, 16oz
products.description: The Jack Rudy Cocktail Company is a family-run company based in Charleston, S.C., and Lexington, KY. They take long-forgotten staples of the American bar and reinvent them so we can enjoy cocktails from the golden age, as our grandparents might have. The small company got a huge boost when the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, GQ, and others praised their debut product Small Batch Tonic. They’ve since added many great products. Their Vermouth Brined Olives are premium cocktail olives in a brine of dry vermouth, juniper and coriander. The hearty olives are designed for classic cocktails and bloody mary’s. The flavorful brine also makes the best dirty martinis.

products.name: Marino Farms Wild Harvested Salted Capers, 6.4oz
products.description: For almost 10 years the Marino family has been producing amazing extra virgin olive oil and fresh herbs from their distinctive territory in Sicily, and in 2018 they began harvesting local fresh capers and salting them with Trapani Sicilian sea salt. We feel lucky to have them on the shelves and in our kitchen!

products.name: Petricor Caviar Olives, 100% Taggiasca Olives in Brine, 200g
products.description: These small and delicate olives are 100% Taggiasca and are hand selected and harvested and processed on the same day. The olives are washed for a month with just water and then continue to ferment in brine, along with thyme and bay leaves. These olives are made naturally, in an ancient tradition of preservation and without the use of starters, chemicals or preservatives. This results in delicate olives produced according to traditional techniques. These olives are an elegant addition to antipasto, cheese plates, tinned seafood, and smoked meat platters. They pair perfectly with white meat like rabbit - a true Ligurian delicacy.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Mixed Olive Salad, 280g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is a delicious mix of Leccino, Nocellara del Belice, and Cerignola olives. Great for antipasti, parties and snacking!

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Olives al Balsamico, 280g
products.description: These Ritrovo Selections olives by Casina Rossa are bathed in aged balsamic and ready for snacking! These firm, rich green olives have a delicate balance of salt, sweet & sour. Perfect for antipasti, with cheese & charcuterie.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Hot Pepper, 280g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with Italian hot peppers. The balanced spice makes these olives perfect for the cocktail hour with a crisp pale ale.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Lemon, 280g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with fresh lemon rind. With notes of bright citrus, these olives compliment cooked dishes as well as martinis.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Truffle, 280g
products.description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with flecks of aromatic truffle. The savory and earthy truffle flavor makes these olives an excellent snack for cocktail hour.

products.name: Tutto Calabria Hot Pepper Stuffed Olives
products.description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. Take that pepper expertise and put in a ripe, firm green olive grown in Southern Italy, and here's what you get. Great for antipasti, snacking & cocktails!

products.name: Villa Jerada Dry Cured Olives, 200g
products.description: Experience the essence of Morocco: Villa Jerada's dry-cured black Beldi olives are hand-harvested, sea-salt cured, and finished with olive oil. Elyse tried them and fell in love. The only cured olives she has ever loved!

products.name: Villa Jerada Non-Pareil Moroccan Capers, 200g
products.description: Handpicked from Morocco's lush Safi region, Villa Jerada capers deliver an unmatched balance of tangy, briny, and zesty flavors - perfect as a garnish or to elevate salads, seafood, and sauces.
